b'# Project Name

This project provides a command-line interface for downloading data from a specified URL.

## Usage

The CLI is executed using the following structure:

`tinydl <url> [options]`

## Command Line Options

### `url` (positional argument)
What to download.

### `-o`, `--output`
File to write (default: stdout).

### `-q`, `--quiet`
No progress output.

## Examples

**Download data to a file:**
`tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -o output.txt`

**Download data to stdout without progress output:**
`tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -q`'
